Account.description: OCSF `account` object: a user account, cloud account, subscription, or billing unit, e.g. an AWS account or a GCP project.

is_disabled.description: Indicates if the account is disabled.

is_locked.description: Indicates if the account is locked, e.g. due to too many failed logins.

is_on_premises_sync_enabled.description: Indicates whether synchronization with an on-premises directory service is enabled, e.g. Microsoft Entra Connect.

labels.description: The list of labels associated with the account.

name.description: The name of the account, e.g. a GCP project name or an AWS account name.

tags.description: The list of key:value tags associated with the account.

type.description: The account type, normalized to the caption of `type_id`.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the account, e.g. an AWS Account ID or a GCP Project ID.

Cloud.description: OCSF `cloud` object: describes details about the cloud service or infrastructure that is the subject of an event, such as the account, region, and availability zone.

account.description: The cloud account, subscription, or billing unit where the event or finding was created.

cloud_partition.description: The logical grouping or isolated segment within a cloud provider's infrastructure, e.g. an AWS partition (`aws`, `aws-cn`, `aws-us-gov`).

org.description: The organizational unit or management structure that governs the account, subscription, or project where the event or finding was created.

project_uid.description: The unique identifier of a Cloud project.

provider.description: The unique name of the Cloud services provider, e.g. `AWS`, `Azure`, `GCP`, or `Oracle Cloud`.

region.description: The cloud region where the event or finding was created, as defined by the cloud provider.

zone.description: The availability zone in the cloud region where the event or finding was created, as defined by the cloud provider.

Container.description: OCSF `container` object: describes an instance of a container, a prepackaged, portable system image that runs isolated on an existing system using a container runtime like `containerd`.

hash.description: The commit hash of the image, or the SHA256 hash of the container.

image.description: The container image used as a template to run the container.

labels.description: The list of labels associated with the container.

network_driver.description: The network driver used by the container, e.g. `bridge`, `overlay`, `host`.

orchestrator.description: The orchestrator managing the container, e.g. `ECS`, `EKS`, `K8s`.

pod_uuid.description: The unique identifier of the pod (or equivalent) that the container is executing on.

runtime.description: The backend running the container, e.g. `containerd` or `cri-o`.

size.description: The size of the container image.

tag.description: The tag used by the container; can indicate version, format, or OS.

tags.description: The list of key:value tags associated with the container.

uid.description: The full container unique identifier for this instantiation of the container.

Device.description: OCSF `device` object: describes characteristics of a device, endpoint, virtual machine, or other resource that is the subject of an event.

agent_list.description: A list of `agent` objects associated with the device.

autoscale_uid.description: The unique identifier of the cloud autoscale configuration.

boot_time.description: The time the system was booted.

boot_uid.description: A unique identifier of the device that changes after every reboot.

container.description: The information describing an instance of a container running on the device.

created_time.description: The time when the device was known to have been created.

desc.description: The description of the device, ordinarily as reported by the operating system.

domain.description: The network domain where the device resides, e.g. `work.example.com`.

eid.description: The Embedded Identity Document: a unique serial number that identifies an eSIM-enabled device.

first_seen_time.description: The initial discovery time of the device.

groups.description: The group names to which the device belongs.

hypervisor.description: The name of the hypervisor running on the device, e.g. `Xen`, `VMware`.

iccid.description: The Integrated Circuit Card Identification of a mobile device.

image.description: The image used as a template to run the virtual machine.

imei.description: The International Mobile Equipment Identity associated with the device.

imei_list.description: The International Mobile Equipment Identity values associated with the device.

instance_uid.description: The unique identifier of a VM instance.

interface_name.description: The name of the network interface, e.g. `eth2`.

interface_uid.description: The unique identifier of the network interface.

ip.description: The device IP address, in either IPv4 or IPv6 format.

is_backed_up.description: Indicates whether the device has a backup enabled, e.g. an automated snapshot or a cloud backup.

is_compliant.description: The event occurred on a compliant device.

is_managed.description: The event occurred on a managed device.

is_mobile_account_active.description: Indicates whether the device has an active mobile account.

is_personal.description: The event occurred on a personal device.

is_shared.description: The event occurred on a shared device.

is_supervised.description: The event occurred on a supervised device (e.g. MDM-managed).

is_trusted.description: The event occurred on a trusted device.

last_seen_time.description: The most recent discovery time of the device.

location.description: The geographical location of the device.

mac.description: The Media Access Control (MAC) address of the endpoint.

mac_vendor.description: The vendor or manufacturer of the endpoint's network interface controller (NIC), as identified from the MAC address.

meid.description: The Mobile Equipment Identifier, a unique number identifying a CDMA mobile device.

model.description: The model of the device, e.g. `ThinkPad X1 Carbon`.

modified_time.description: The time when the device was last known to have been modified.

name.description: The alternate device name, ordinarily as assigned by an administrator.

namespace_pid.description: If running under a process namespace (such as in a container), the process identifier within that namespace.

network_interfaces.description: The physical or virtual network interfaces associated with the device, one for each unique MAC/IP/hostname/name combination.

org.description: Organization and org unit related to the device.

os_machine_uuid.description: The operating system assigned Machine ID.

owner.description: The identity of the service or user account that owns the endpoint or was last logged into it.

pool.description: The pool of desktops or virtual machines to which the endpoint belongs.

region.description: The region where the virtual machine is located, e.g. an AWS Region.

risk_level.description: The risk level, normalized to the caption of `risk_level_id`.

risk_score.description: The risk score as reported by the event source.

subnet_uid.description: The unique identifier of a virtual subnet.

udid.description: The Apple assigned Unique Device Identifier (UDID).

uid.description: The unique identifier of the device, e.g. the Windows TargetSID or AWS EC2 ARN.

uid_alt.description: An alternate unique identifier of the device, if any, e.g. the ActiveDirectory DN.

vendor_name.description: The vendor for the device, e.g. `Dell` or `Lenovo`.

vpc_uid.description: The unique identifier of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

zone.description: The network zone or LAN segment.

Group.description: OCSF `group` object: the grouping of individuals with similar rights, interests, or objectives, such as an administrative or membership group.

domain.description: The domain where the group is defined, e.g. the LDAP or Active Directory domain.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the group, e.g. a Windows SID.

uid_alt.description: The alternate unique identifier of the group.

Image.description: OCSF `image` object: describes the container image used as a template to instantiate a container.

labels.description: The list of labels associated with the image.

path.description: The full path to the image file.

tags.description: The list of key:value tags associated with the image.

Metadata.description: OCSF `metadata` object: describes the metadata associated with the event.

correlation_uid.description: A unique identifier used to correlate this event with other related events.

debug.description: Debug information about non-fatal issues with this event.

event_code.description: The identifier of the original event (e.g. Windows Event Code).

extension.description: The schema extension used to create the event. Deprecated in favor of `extensions`.

extensions.description: The schema extensions used to create the event.

is_truncated.description: Indicates whether the OCSF event data has been truncated.

labels.description: The list of labels attached to the event.

log_format.description: The format of data in the log where the data originated.

log_level.description: The level at which an event was logged.

log_provider.description: The logging provider or logging service that logged the event.

log_source.description: The log system or component where the data originated.

log_version.description: The event log schema version of the original event.

logged_time.description: The time when the logging system collected and logged the event.

loggers.description: The pipeline of devices and logging products between the source and destination.

modified_time.description: The time when the event was last modified or enriched.

original_event_uid.description: The unique identifier assigned to the event in its original logging system.

original_time.description: The original event time as reported by the event source.

processed_time.description: The event processed time, such as an ETL operation.

product.description: The product that reported the event.

profiles.description: The list of profiles used to create the event.

reporter.description: The entity from which the event or finding was first reported.

sequence.description: Sequence number of the event, for unambiguous ordering.

source.description: The source of the event or finding.

tags.description: The list of key:value tags associated with the event.

total_queued_duration.description: The amount of time an event spent in a queue awaiting processing.

transformation_info_list.description: An array of transformation info describing mappings/transforms applied to the data.

transmit_time.description: The time when the event was transmitted from the logging device to its next destination.

type.description: The type of the event or finding, as a subset of `source`.

uid.description: A unique identifier assigned to the OCSF event.

untruncated_size.description: The original size of the OCSF event data in kilobytes before truncation.

version.description: The version of the OCSF schema (SemVer) used to produce the event.

Organization.description: OCSF `organization` object: describes characteristics of an organization or a Cloud tenant/organizational unit, e.g. an AWS Organization or a Google Cloud Organization.

name.description: The name of the organization, e.g. `Widget, Inc.`.

ou_name.description: The name of an organizational unit, Google Cloud Folder, or AWS Org Unit.

ou_uid.description: The unique identifier of an organizational unit, Google Cloud Folder, or AWS Org Unit.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the organization, e.g. an AWS Org ID.

Os.description: OCSF `os` object: describes characteristics of an operating system.

country.description: The operating system country code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2), e.g. `US`.

cpe_name.description: The Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) name, e.g. `cpe:/a:apple:safari:16.2`.

cpu_bits.description: The CPU architecture: the number of bits used for addressing in memory, e.g. `32` or `64`.

kernel_release.description: The kernel release of the operating system, e.g. `5.15.0-122-generic`.

lang.description: The two-letter lower case language code (ISO 639-1), e.g. `en`.

sp_name.description: The name of the latest Service Pack.

sp_ver.description: The version number of the latest Service Pack.

type.description: The type of the operating system.

type_id.description: The type identifier of the operating system.

version.description: The version of the OS running on the device that originated the event, e.g. `Windows 10`, `OS X 10.7`, or `iOS 9`.

Product.description: OCSF `product` object: describes characteristics of a software product.

cpe_name.description: The Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) name of the product.

feature.description: The feature that reported the event.

lang.description: The two letter lower case language code (ISO 639-1) of the product.

path.description: The installation path of the product.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the product.

url_string.description: The URL pointing towards the product.

vendor_name.description: The name of the vendor of the product.

version.description: The version of the product, as defined by the event source.

ResourceDetails.description: OCSF `resource_details` object: describes details about the resource that is the subject of an event or finding, e.g. a cloud resource, device, or file.

agent_list.description: A list of `agent` objects associated with the resource.

cloud_partition.description: The logical grouping or isolated segment within a cloud provider's infrastructure where the resource is located.

created_time.description: The time when the resource was created.

criticality.description: The criticality of the resource as defined by the event source.

group.description: The name of the related resource group.

hostname.description: The fully qualified name of the resource.

ip.description: The IP address of the resource, in either IPv4 or IPv6 format.

is_backed_up.description: Indicates whether the resource has a backup enabled.

labels.description: The list of labels associated with the resource.

modified_time.description: The time when the resource was last modified.

namespace.description: The namespace, useful when similar entities exist that need to be kept separate.

owner.description: The details of the entity that owns the resource.

provider.description: The cloud service provider that hosts or manages the resource.

region.description: The cloud region where the resource is hosted, as defined by the cloud provider.

resource_relationship.description: A graph representation showing how this resource relates to other entities in the environment.

role.description: The role of the resource in the context of the event or finding, normalized to the caption of `role_id`.

role_id.description: The normalized identifier of the resource's role in the context of the event or finding.

tags.description: The list of key:value tags associated with the resource.

type.description: The resource type as defined by the event source.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

uid_alt.description: The alternative unique identifier of the resource.

version.description: The version of the resource, e.g. `1.2.3`.

zone.description: The availability zone within a cloud region where the resource is located.

User.description: OCSF `user` object: describes the user identity and characteristics.

account.description: The user's account or the account associated with the user.

credential_uid.description: The unique identifier of the user's credential, e.g. an AWS Access Key ID.

display_name.description: The display name of the user, as reported by the product.

domain.description: The domain where the user is defined, e.g. the LDAP or Active Directory domain.

full_name.description: The full name of the user, as reported by the product.

groups.description: The administrative groups to which the user belongs.

has_mfa.description: The user has a multi-factor or secondary-factor device assigned.

ldap_person.description: The additional LDAP attributes that describe a person.

org.description: Organization and org unit related to the user.

phone_number.description: The telephone number of the user.

programmatic_credentials.description: Details about the programmatic credentials (API keys, access tokens, certificates, etc.) associated with the user.

risk_level.description: The risk level, normalized to the caption of `risk_level_id`.

risk_score.description: The risk score as reported by the event source.

type.description: The type of the user, e.g. `System`, `AWS IAM User`.

uid.description: The unique user identifier, e.g. the Windows user SID, ActiveDirectory DN, or AWS user ARN.

uid_alt.description: The alternate user identifier, e.g. the Active Directory user GUID or AWS user Principal ID.

description: OCSF `cloud_resources_inventory_info` (class 5023): the discovery result of a cloud resource (e.g. container, database, data bucket, identity provider) discovered by an inventory process.

action_id.description: The action taken by a control or other policy-based system leading to an outcome or disposition.

activity_id.description: The normalized identifier of the activity that triggered the event.

activity_name.description: The event activity name, as defined by the activity_id.

actor.description: The actor object describes details about the user/role/process that was the source of the activity.

api.description: Describes details about a typical API (Application Programming Interface) call.

attacks.description: An array of MITRE ATT&CK® objects describing identified tactics, techniques & sub-techniques.

authorizations.description: Provides details about an authorization, such as authorization outcome, and any associated policies related to the activity/event.

category_name.description: The event category name, as defined by category_uid value: Discovery.

category_uid.description: The category unique identifier of the event.

class_name.description: The event class name, as defined by class_uid value: Cloud Resources Inventory Info.

class_uid.description: The unique identifier of a class.

cloud.description: Cloud service provider or SaaS platform metadata about the cloud resource(s) that are being discovered by an inventory process.

confidence.description: The confidence, normalized to the caption of the confidence_id value.

confidence_id.description: The normalized confidence refers to the accuracy of the rule that created the finding.

confidence_score.description: The confidence score as reported by the event source.

container.description: A cloud-based container image or running container discovered by an inventory process.

count.description: The number of times that events in the same logical group occurred during the event Start Time to End Time period.

database.description: A cloud-based database discovered by an inventory process.

databucket.description: A cloud-based data bucket or other object storage discovered by an inventory process.

device.description: An addressable device, computer system or host.

disposition.description: The disposition name, normalized to the caption of the disposition_id value.

disposition_id.description: Describes the outcome or action taken by a security control, such as access control checks, malware detections or various types of policy violations.

duration.description: The event duration or aggregate time, the amount of time the event covers from start_time to end_time in milliseconds.

end_time.description: The end time of a time period, or the time of the most recent event included in the aggregate event.

end_time_dt.description: The end time of a time period, or the time of the most recent event included in the aggregate event.

enrichments.description: The additional information from an external data source, which is associated with the event or a finding.

firewall_rule.description: The firewall rule that pertains to the control that triggered the event, if applicable.

idp.description: The Identity Provider that is being discovered by an inventory process, or that is related to the cloud resource(s) being discovered by an inventory process.

is_alert.description: Indicates that the event is considered to be an alertable signal.

malware.description: A list of Malware objects, describing details about the identified malware.

malware_scan_info.description: Describes details about the scan job that identified malware on the target system.

message.description: The description of the event/finding, as defined by the source.

metadata.description: The metadata associated with the event or a finding.

observables.description: The observables associated with the event or a finding.

policy.description: The policy that pertains to the control that triggered the event, if applicable.

raw_data.description: The raw event/finding data as received from the source.

raw_data_hash.description: The hash, which describes the content of the raw_data field.

raw_data_size.description: The size of the raw data which was transformed into an OCSF event, in bytes.

region.description: The cloud region where the resource is located, e.g. us-isof-south-1, eastus2, us-central1, etc.

resources.description: The cloud resource(s) that are being discovered by an inventory process. Use this object if there is not a direct object match in the class.

risk_details.description: Describes the risk associated with the finding.

risk_level.description: The risk level, normalized to the caption of the risk_level_id value.

risk_score.description: The risk score as reported by the event source.

severity.description: The event/finding severity, normalized to the caption of the severity_id value.

severity_id.description: The normalized identifier of the event/finding severity. Smaller numerical values represent lower impact events, larger represent higher impact events.

start_time.description: The start time of a time period, or the time of the least recent event included in the aggregate event.

start_time_dt.description: The start time of a time period, or the time of the least recent event included in the aggregate event.

status.description: The event status, normalized to the caption of the status_id value.

status_code.description: The event status code, as reported by the event source.

status_detail.description: The status detail contains additional information about the event/finding outcome.

status_id.description: The normalized identifier of the event status.

table.description: A cloud-based database table discovered by an inventory process.

time.description: The normalized event occurrence time or the finding creation time.

time_dt.description: The normalized event occurrence time or the finding creation time.

timezone_offset.description: The number of minutes that the reported event time is ahead or behind UTC, in the range -1,080 to +1,080.

type_name.description: The event/finding type name, as defined by the type_uid.

type_uid.description: The event/finding type ID. It identifies the event's semantics and structure: class_uid * 100 + activity_id.

unmapped.description: The attributes that are not mapped to the event schema.
